entry.description: The name the connector is exported under in the bundle.

description.description: What it is for, in plain text.

configSchema.description: A JSON Schema for a connection's configuration. A connection that uses this connector is checked against it when it is bound, and the console draws its form from it.

source.description: The TypeScript the resource was written as, for a resource managed in the console. Its default export is what runs.

language.description: The language it is written in. Only `typescript`.

code.description: The code itself. It may import the SDK and `node:` modules only.
